content.title: Anthropic Debuts on US Stock Market, Protesters Rally in New York and San Francisco
content.caption: The artificial intelligence startup Anthropic debuted on the US stock market at an eye-popping $2tn valuation on Thursday, raising about $81bn to continue developing its Claude family of generative AI models. Protesters from anti-AI groups rallied in front of the Nasdaq exchange at its New York City headquarters in Times Square and several were arrested.
